literal: Of conduct those who renounced greatness in excellence desires text conclusion
translation: The firm conclusion of all texts of wisdom is to exalt the greatness of those who have renounced worldly attachments through righteous conduct as the highest excellence.
modern: நல்லொழுக்கத்தின் வழியே பற்றுகளைத் துறந்தவர்களின் பெருமையையே மிகச் சிறந்ததாகக் கருதுவது எல்லா நூல்களின் முடிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme value of renunciation when it is firmly grounded in righteous conduct. The word பனுவல் refers to texts or books of wisdom, and துணிவு means their final conclusion or resolve. It states that all works of wisdom ultimately agree in exalting the greatness of those who have given up worldly attachments through pure conduct, placing it at the pinnacle of excellence.
